quarterly_data.signal: ReefIQ commercial model (per the company): a ReefIQ deployment is structured differently from the fee-for-service projects and seat-based subscriptions that made up most of MindWalk's historical revenue - licensing is metered on the data a client holds in the platform and the compute it runs against that data, so revenue scales with discovery activity rather than headcount; the relationships are multi-year by design, and a deployment typically begins with data management and widens into analytical tools and custom models on the same context. The company says ReefIQ agreements should not be benchmarked against its historical LensAI agreements; ReefIQ has been commercially available since June 2026 and LensAI is in contracted, recurring arrangements with life sciences clients.
